cronjob/audit-log-archiver.name: audit-log-archiver

containers.name: archiver
command:
set -eu
echo "[$(date -u '+%FT%TZ')] archiver: starting audit log archive"
echo "[$(date -u '+%FT%TZ')] archiver: bundling /var/log/audit"
attempt=0
until printf 'audit-archive-ready\n' | nc -w 2 127.0.0.1 24224 >/dev/null; do
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  if [ "$attempt" -ge 10 ]; then
    echo "archiver: log forwarding unavailable" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "[$(date -u '+%FT%TZ')] archiver: audit record forwarded"
sleep 1
echo "[$(date -u '+%FT%TZ')] archiver: upload complete (0 bytes archived)"

containers.name: fluent-bit-sidecar
command:
echo "[$(date -u '+%FT%TZ')] fluent-bit: binding to forward port 24224"
echo "[$(date -u '+%FT%TZ')] fluent-bit: ready to receive log streams"
exec nc -lk -p 24224 -e cat
